context: ROCKET INTERNET’S INCREASED STAKES IN ITS LEADING e-COMMERCE BUSINESSES MANILA, Philippines, 22 nd August 2014 – Philippine Long Distance Telephone Company (“PLDT”) (PSE:TEL) (NYSE:PHI), the leading telecoms operator in the Philippines, welcomed the entry of Holtzbrinck Ventures (“HV”) in Rocket Internet. HV, a long-term, early-stage investor in companies started by Rocket, is contributing its entire stakes in seven of Rocket’s most developed e-commerce businesses directly into Rocket, in exchange for equity in Rocket.
